verdict.rationale: Unity documents a first-party WebGL build target for publishing real-time 3D games to the browser, which covers the 'WebGL today' part of the story. The pack has no evidence on payload or build size, compression, or any WebGPU support or roadmap. Missing for 10: evidence of reasonable or optimizable web payload size, a documented WebGPU backend or roadmap, depth beyond a single WebGL manual line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story

citations.quote: WebGL lets you publish real-time interactive 3D graphics into a browser.
